text:
dmitri: heads up — apiserver p95/99 spikes in eu-north for last ~10m, flat 429/503s during gpu-staging attach waves
jen: seeing that too, controller-manager lease queue length up, controllers stuck reconciling pods
lia: quick look — watchcache redispatch rate jumped at same time as a batch of GPU nodes came online in staging
maria: any NAT/SNAT alerts? we've hit SNAT caps before on attach storms
ops-bot: [alert] nat-gateway-eunorth SNAT-used 98% — threshold breached at 10:04 UTC :warning:
dmitri: bingo. retries on pod connect -> watch fanout -> apiserver backpressure. staging attaches are retrying fast and causing head-of-line issues
jen: snippet from apiserver logs: `E0420 10:05:12.123] watch cache redispatcher: requeue 512 items, dispatch latency 250ms`
lia: can we throttle attach retries on the staging agent? current backoff is tiny for ephemeral workloads
maria: also noticed kube-proxy conn tracking spikes on host, could be contributing to NAT exhaustion
dmitri: plan idea: 1) pause new GPU attach jobs in staging 2) temporarily increase SNAT ports on nat-gw 3) move some attach traffic to dedicated fallback pool
oncall-sre: I'm on it — bumping SNAT ports on nat-gw-eunorth by +50% now (ETA ~2m) :hourglass_flowing_sand:
jen: pausing attach pipeline (staging-runner) — toggled a flag in CI, stopping new attach attempts
lia: adding a quick iptables tweak to reduce conn tracking TTL on staging hosts, should free up NAT sooner 
ops-bot: [deploy] staging-runner toggle -> SUCCESS by jen at 10:08 UTC :white_check_mark:
dmitri: good. also let's set a short-term autoscale guard on gpu-staging to limit burst to +10 nodes until we stabilize
maria: cost callout: reducing burst will prevent extra dedicated fallback spend, but may impact test throughput — okay for now
jen: verifying controller-manager metrics — lease queue dropped from 320 -> 40 since attach pause
lia: SNAT ports report shows used -> 55% after nat bump and conntrack tweak, looks healthier
dmitri: follow-ups: create ticket to add attach-rate limiter in provisioner, and add watchcache redispatch alert rule tied to rapid attach events
oncall-sre: filing incident ticket and pinging networking for long-term NAT scale review
maria: also schedule a runbook update: how to throttle attaches and failover to fallback pool without human-in-loop
jen: thanks all — continuing to monitor, will unpause staging when stable :thumbsup:
dmitri: appreciate the quick moves. leaving monitoring on — reopen if p95 climbs back above 400ms
ops-bot: [metric] apiserver.p95.eu-north = 210ms at 10:13 UTC
lia: small note — this pattern repeats when we have many ephemeral GPU CI jobs in parallel; suggest a provisioning cap in CI for eu region
maria: agreed. adding to roadmap item for Q2: "provisioner backpressure controls + region egress guardrails"
jen: last check: controller-manager lease queue at 12, apiserver 5xxs near zero, watch redispatch calm
dmitri: closing thread for now. will keep an eye on nightly CI spike tomorrow :eyes:
